evals.name: discover-and-parse-rpp-routing
evals.prompt: Find my REAPER projects on disk and inspect the routing and FX chains for the project named 'Rock Song' without modifying anything.
evals.expected_output: Calls find_reaper_projects() to locate the matching .RPP path, then calls parse_reaper_project(project_path) and summarizes tempo, track folder/routing (main_send, receives), and FX chains read-only.
assertions: Calls find_reaper_projects() first instead of guessing .RPP paths
Calls parse_reaper_project(project_path) using the discovered path
Notes tracks with main_send: false and active receives when explaining routing

evals.name: pre-fx-vocal-audio-audit
evals.prompt: Audit the vocal tracks in my closed .RPP project for clipping, DC offset, boxy low mids, or phase issues across the regions actually used in the arrangement.
evals.expected_output: Calls analyze_audio_files(project_path, track_filter='Vocal', whole_file=False) and reports level, spectral, stereo, dynamics findings and warnings while noting all measurements are pre-FX/pre-fader.
assertions: Uses track_filter and keeps whole_file=False so only played regions (SOFFS + LENGTH * playrate) are analyzed
Explicitly states that analyze_audio_files measurements are pre-FX and pre-fader (raw disk source audio)
Reports any triggered warnings (peak > -0.3 dBFS, DC offset, 200-500 Hz tilt, phase coherence < 0.5, LUFS/crest factor)

evals.name: installed-fx-cache-search
evals.prompt: Check my REAPER plugin cache for installed VST3 compressor or reverb plugins.
evals.expected_output: Calls list_installed_fx with search_query or plugin_type='VST3' (remembering search_query takes precedence over plugin_type in a single call) and notes results reflect REAPER's last plugin scan on disk.
assertions: Accounts for search_query taking precedence over plugin_type if filtering by both
Notes results come from REAPER's disk plugin cache (.ini)
